如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    陈雨舒忙跟在楚梦瑶的后面，对林逸做了个鬼脸，瞪了他一眼，就匆匆上了楼去。
“至于这么大反应么？”
林逸摇了摇头，看着桌上的美食，心想，看样子她们也不能下来吃了，这些应该都归自己了。
于是，林逸拿起筷子，开始左右开动，风卷残云般的扫光了桌上的四菜一汤……
楚梦瑶回到了房间，便倒在了床上，她觉得自己很悲剧，也很委屈。
凭什么呀，自己的初吻怎么就这么没了呢？
要是个帅帅的男孩儿也好呀，偏偏是林逸这个乡巴佬，土老帽！
“小舒，你说我怎么这么倒霉呀！”
楚梦瑶忍不住委屈的哭出了声来，刚才在外面，有林逸在，楚梦瑶不想叫他看笑话，是以强忍着自己的情绪。
虽然眼泪都掉了下来，但是却没有发出任何声音，现在只剩下了她和陈雨舒了，她也顾不得那么多了。
“喔，瑶瑶姐，别伤心了，还好是间接的接吻，没有直接嘴对嘴，他也没占到什么便宜不是！”
陈雨舒心想，最多是你吃了些箭牌哥的口水，他也没吃到你的口水！
陈雨舒不说还好，一说楚梦瑶更觉得委屈，要是真接吻了，自己也认了，偏偏自己吃了亏，还没讨到好！
林逸没得到便宜，也不会觉得同情愧疚，而自己却只能自认倒霉！
“不行，我决定了，明天我就和爹地说，这个家里有我没他，有他没我！”
楚梦瑶恨恨的说道：“一定要……”
楚梦瑶也哭累了，吐累了，抱怨了一阵子，就迷迷糊糊的睡去了。
陈雨舒摇了摇头，躺在了她的身边，心想，不就是吃了点儿口水么，也没什么大不了的呀，又不会怀孕，至于么？
吃完了饭，林逸也做好了挨批的准备，没办法，谁让自己的身份低微呢？
要是换做旧社会，那自己就是个下人，将大小姐惹不高兴了指不定会受到什么处罚呢。

不过，等了半天也不见得有人下来，林逸就将桌上的餐盒收拾了一下，然后回到了自己的房间。
已经九点多了，楚梦瑶她们大概也已经睡了，不会再下来了。
林逸洗了脸刷了牙之后，就将房门反锁了起来，然后坐在了床上，开始修炼起轩辕驭龙诀来。
这套功法的来历很特别，是他从一个山洞里面发现的。
记得那是林逸八岁的时候，在一个月圆之夜，老头子将他叫到了西星山顶，要考校一下他最近的功夫进展。
林逸不明白老头子为什么大半夜的叫自己去山顶考校功夫，但是在老头子一贯的高压政策之下，林逸还是乖乖的和老头子一起上了山顶。
可是，切磋了两招之后，林逸就明显的感觉不对劲儿了！
老头子这哪里是考校啊，简直是下死手！
林逸刚想开口说什么，屁股上就感到了一股大力袭来，被老头子狠狠的一脚踢下了山谷。
林逸只觉得两耳间嗖嗖的风声响起，自己就像动画片里的奥特慢一样在天空中飞翔了起来。
过了很久，林逸才“砰”的一声重重的摔落在地上！
林逸只觉得自己的骨头架子都要散了一样！
虽然从三岁开始，就被老头子用中药每天浸泡全身改善了身体的筋骨和体质，但是从如此高的山头上摔下来，还是将林逸摔了个七荤八素，晕了过去。
看着林逸摔落的方向，林老头摇了摇头，叹道：
“小逸啊，不是爷爷狠心，实在是机不可失失不再来啊，洞门每五年的中秋月圆之夜才不知道过了多久，林逸才悠悠转醒，先大骂了几句林老头的不厚道，才爬起身来。
没办法，现在这个时候骂也没有用，林逸先检查了一下自己的身子，发现没有大碍之后，才站起身来。
不过，眼前所看到的景象却让林逸大吃一惊！在他的面前，是一座造型古朴却气势磅礴的巨型山门！
朱红色的油漆在月光下闪闪发亮，上面的金黄色的门环发出夺目的光彩！
这就好似是神话里面，神仙的驻地一般！在巨门的上方，有一块牌匾，上书四个大字：“轩辕洞府”。
这是什么地方？

林逸的呼吸都变得有些急促起来，他在西星山生活许多年，却从来也没听说过，在西星山的底部，还有这么一个地方！
虽然林逸不知道自己为什么会跌跌撞撞的来到这里，老头子怎么那么凑巧一脚就把自己踢到了山洞门口，但是林逸却是有一种熟悉的感觉！

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast track. Chen Yushu hurriedly followed Chu Mengyao, made a face at Lin Yi, glared at him, and hurried upstairs.
"As for such a big reaction?"
Lin Yi shook his head, looked at the food on the table, and thought to himself, it seems that they can't come down to eat, so these should all belong to him.
So, Lin Yi picked up the chopsticks and started moving them left and right, sweeping away the four dishes and one soup on the table...
Chu Mengyao returned to the room and fell on the bed. She felt very tragic and wronged.
Why, why did my first kiss end like this?
It doesn't matter if it's a handsome boy, but it's Lin Yi, a country bumpkin and an old hat!
"Xiao Shu, why am I so unlucky?"
Chu Mengyao couldn't help but cried out in grievance. Lin Yi was outside just now. Chu Mengyao didn't want him to see a joke, so she suppressed her emotions.
Although tears fell, she didn't make any sound. Now she and Chen Yushu were the only ones left, and she couldn't care less.
"Oh, Sister Yaoyao, don't be sad. Fortunately, it was an indirect kiss, not direct mouth to mouth, so he didn't take advantage!"
Chen Yushu thought to herself, at most you might have eaten some of Brother Wrigley's saliva, but he didn't eat any of your saliva either!
Chen Yushu didn't say it was okay, but when he told Chu Mengyao, he felt even more aggrieved. If they really kissed, he would admit it, but he would suffer the loss and not get the benefit!
Lin Yi didn't get any advantage, nor did he feel sympathy or guilt, but he could only admit that he was unlucky!
"No, I have decided. Tomorrow I will tell dad that there will be me in this family without him, and he will be without me in this family!"
Chu Mengyao said bitterly: "You must..."
Chu Mengyao was tired of crying and vomiting. She complained for a while and then fell asleep in a daze.
Chen Yushu shook her head and lay next to her, thinking, isn't it just a little saliva, it's not a big deal, and she won't be pregnant, so what?
After finishing the meal, Lin Yi was ready to be criticized. He had no choice but to let his status be low.
If he were in the old society, he would be a servant, and he might be punished if he made the eldest lady unhappy.
However, after waiting for a long time and no one came down, Lin Yi packed up the lunch boxes on the table and returned to his room.
It was already past nine o'clock, and Chu Mengyao and the others had probably gone to bed and would not come down again.
After Lin Yi washed his face and brushed his teeth, he locked the door, sat on the bed, and began to practice the Xuanyuan Dragon Control Technique.
The origin of this set of exercises is very special. He discovered it from a cave.
I remember it was when Lin Yi was eight years old. On a full moon night, the old man called him to the top of Xixing Mountain to test his recent kung fu progress.
Lin Yi didn't understand why the old man asked him to go to the top of the mountain to take a kung fu test in the middle of the night. However, under the old man's consistent high-pressure policy, Lin Yi obediently went to the top of the mountain with the old man.
However, after practicing two moves, Lin Yi clearly felt that something was wrong!
This old man is not an examination school. He is simply a killer!
Just as Lin Yi was about to say something, he felt a strong force on his butt and was kicked down the valley by the old man.
Lin Yi only felt the whistling sound of wind between his ears, and he was flying in the sky like Ultraman in the cartoon.
After a long time, Lin Yi fell to the ground with a loud "bang"!
Lin Yi felt as if his bones were falling apart!
Although the old man had been soaking his whole body with Chinese medicine every day since he was three years old to improve his body's muscles and physique, falling from such a high mountain still knocked Lin Yi to pieces and fainted.
Looking at the direction in which Lin Yi fell, Lin YiThe old man shook his head and sighed:
"Xiao Yi, it's not that grandpa is cruel, it's that the opportunity must not come back again. I don't know how long it has been since the full moon night of the Mid-Autumn Festival every five years in the cave. Lin Yi slowly woke up. He cursed a few words about Old Lin's unkindness before getting up.
There was no way, there was no use scolding him at this time. Lin Yi checked his body first and found that there was no serious problem before he stood up.
However, what he saw in front of him shocked Lin Yi! In front of him was a giant mountain gate with a simple but majestic shape!
The vermilion paint shines in the moonlight, and the golden door knocker on it shines with dazzling brilliance!
This is like the residence of gods in mythology! Above the huge door, there is a plaque with four characters: "Xuanyuan Cave Mansion".
What is this place?
Lin Yi's breathing became a little rapid. He had lived in Xixing Mountain for many years, but he had never heard of such a place at the bottom of Xixing Mountain!
Although Lin Yi didn't know why he stumbled here, and how the old man happened to kick himself to the entrance of the cave, Lin Yi felt familiar!
